lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
How many edges does a triangular prism have?

FEEDBACK
9 edges.

WATCH FOR
Forgetting the base edges of pyramids undercounts.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.

lesson.parent_notes:
Parent: Marking guidance for the independent task: Complete an eighteen-item 3D fluency set. Recount any item you miss using a checklist. Accept equivalent original responses that show the same skill.

Parent: Written model 1: Sample: new numbers solved with visible working for fluency; key places/values named. Do not award marks for retyping the model.

Parent: Written model 2: Sample misconception: Forgetting the base edges of pyramids undercounts.. Correction uses 9 edges.. Why: restores accurate fluency.

Parent: Likely misconception: Forgetting the base edges of pyramids undercounts. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

Parent: Short-answer focus 1: Solve one fresh problem that uses fluency with different numbers from the worked model. Show working and name the places or values that matter.

Parent: Short-answer focus 2: Describe one likely mistake with fluency, show corrected working, and say why the correction works.

Parent: Marking notes: Accept any mathematically valid solution that uses new numbers, shows working for fluency, and names places/values. Reject copied model numbers. / Accept a named misconception about fluency, corrected working, and a method reason. Reject vague “I was wrong” with no repair..

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
Set: cube counts; cylinder faces; name a pentagonal prism. Prefer systematic counting over glance guesses.

TRY FIRST
How many edges does a triangular prism have?

FEEDBACK
9 edges.
teach_steps.explain:
3D fluency practises counting faces, edges and vertices and naming prisms/pyramids from properties.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
teach_steps.notice: Forgetting the base edges of pyramids undercounts. Correct the value or method, not just the appearance of the digits.
